caseNameFull: United States v. WILLIAM G. PRICE, JR., CORA PRESSON PARTRIDGE, and FREDERICK M. WATERBURY

opinions.text:
Pay and allowances; recognition of service in National Guard for purposes of retired pay of Army officer. Plaintiffs entitled to recover. .

Defendant’s petitions for writs of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court January 5, 1953.
